feeds.title: Maryland Grows
feeds.description: We help Maryland residents grow! Learn timely tips to manage your lawn, ornamental plants, and food gardens, with advice from University of Maryland experts and certified horticulturists.

feeds.title: Garden Goods Direct Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with the latest gardening know how! Read about plant care, growing tips, how to choose plants, and garden designs. Garden Goods Direct is an online garden center and plant nursery where you can buy plants and trees online.

feeds.title: Homestead Gardens
feeds.description: From questions on houseplant health, to the best time to plant bulbs, to how to decorate your front porch, this is the garden blog for you! We offer landscaping design and build service, outdoor lighting, garden accessories, casual furniture, gifts & decor, and much, much more!

feeds.title: Greenstreet Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Greenstreet Gardens started in the greenhouse - growing plants and learning what it took for them to flourish in the landscape. From this first-hand knowledge, Ray and Stacy Greenstreet share the best advice to keep your gardening a successful experience.

feeds.title: The Garden Diaries Blog
feeds.description: A garden/floral designer who has had a trowel in hand and dirty fingernails since I was four years old, I have over 30 years of hands-on experience. I am Claire - a writer, consultant, teacher, lecturer, beekeeper, and garden designer. I love to write about all my successes and failures (many of these!) in gardening.

feeds.title: Direct Native Plants Blog
feeds.description: Learn all about the Native Plants industry including tips, best practices, and other insights from the experts at Direct Native Plants. Direct Native Plants is committed to growing and distributing native plants that are not only beautiful but critical to the establishment of biodiverse natural ecosystems.

feeds.title: Chesapeake Family » Home and Garden
feeds.description: Ideas and improvement projects for your home and garden including tips, advice, and information on gardening in Maryland, flowers and plants, home decor and interior design, home repair, furniture and more.

feeds.title: Bru-Mar Gardens Blog
feeds.description: News, Tips, and Ideas. Founded in 1999 by Bruce Martin and Martin Perkins, we offer a large selection of quality grown plant material including annuals, perennials, shrubs and trees, and native plants, as well as bird food, feeders and supplies, gardening supplies, soils and mulches, garden accents and decorative accessories, planters and accessories, patio furniture, and grills.

feeds.title: Native Plants with Adams Garden
feeds.description: In this blog, I will write about my experiences of using North American native plants in the residential landscape in the Mid-Atlantic US. In particular, I will focus on working with Native Annuals and Biennials and how they can add surprises to the garden. Adams Garden is an owner-operated Landscape Design company in west-central Maryland with a focus on native plants and sustainable landscape practices.

feeds.title: Garden Girls LLC Blog
feeds.description: Garden Girls blog will provide you with gardening and landscaping advice and ideas that will help you maintain your front and backyard. Loni is a lifelong gardener with a degree from Rocky Mountain College in Montana, where she majored in Environmental Studies, and a masters in ESL from School for International Training, Loni has over two decades of experience in the green industry, starting as a maintenance gardener for a high-end garden service, and moving on to operations manager at a local landscaping firm before starting Garden Girls.

feeds.title: The Rusted Garden Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find articles all about vegetable gardening. How to start seeds, tend plants and grow vegetables. Ways to fertilize plants, manage pests and diseases and harvest and cook home garden vegetables.

feeds.title: Garden Head
feeds.description: Gardening in and around Zone 6-7 in the midAtlantic northeast for 15 years. I write about Gardens and tell stories about plants as part of my actual job, and in my spare time I think about plants, read about plants, buy plants, poke at plants, eat plants, and plant plants. If left to my own devices I will binge old episodes of Gardener's World.

feeds.title: Lauren's Garden Service Blog
feeds.description: The blog offes tips for your garden. With over 20 years of gardening experience, Lauren is the founder and owner of Lauren's Garden Services. Lauren's Garden Service is dedicated to creating beautiful outdoor spaces for people to enjoy. We take the hard work out of gardening by doing it for you!

feeds.title: Beyond Behnke's Blog
feeds.description: At Beyond Behnke's, we provide resources to help gardeners in all aspects of their gardening experience. We believe gardening techniques and strategies should be readily available to everyone, and that collaborating in an authentic online environment can provide gardeners the resources they need to grow.
